reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Tone Brightening Tone-Up Sunscreen 50mL
reviews.text: This sunscreen feels light on your skin yet gives strong, reliable protection, sinking in quickly without leaving a greasy film. Its smooth texture makes it easy to apply evenly, and it wears comfortably throughout the day. It keeps your skin moisturized while shielding it from the sun, making it a simple, dependable choice for daily use. It will leave a white cast on darker skin.
reviews.zh: 呢支防曬搽喺皮膚上感覺輕盈，但提供強效可靠嘅防護，吸收快，唔會留低油笠薄膜。質地滑順易搽均勻，全日戴住都好舒服。佢幫皮膚保濕同時抵擋太陽，係日常使用簡單又可靠嘅選擇。不過喺深色皮膚上會泛白。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Tone Brightening Tone-Up Sunscreen 50mL
reviews.text: I first tried it from a sample I got at Olive Young, loved it, and ended up purchasing it. It applies as smoothly as a serum, has zero white cast, no dryness, and no stinging around the eyes. Just an overall excellent product.
reviews.zh: 本來喺 Olive Young 試到 sample，一試就愛上，結果買咗正裝。搽起上嚟同精華一樣滑，零泛白，唔會乾燥，眼周都唔會吉。整體係一流嘅產品。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Tone Brightening Tone-Up Sunscreen 50mL
reviews.text:
Decepción total!!!
Deja una capa blanca terrible, nunca se deja de absorber he incluso debajo del maquillaje se ve blanco , la textura no es mala y supongo que el producto es bueno no lo volvería a comprar eso de parecer fantasma no me gusta
reviews.zh:
徹底失望！！！
留低一層恐怖嘅白色，點都吸收唔到，化妝底下都仲係白嘅，質地又唔算差，我諗產品本身應該唔錯，但我唔會再買，因為唔想睇落似個鬼，唔鍾意。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Tone Brightening Tone-Up Sunscreen 50mL
reviews.text: Since this brand is so popular specially for their sunscreen, i have decides to try this one because i like tone up creams for brightens my skin tone, it’s good that this product is also a sunscreen, so this is what I’m looking for the combination of tone up and suncreen. I love the texture and super smooth and glowy. Not too white just moderate 💯
reviews.zh: 因為呢個品牌嘅防曬特別出名，我就嚟試呢款。我鍾意用調色霜去提亮膚色，好彩呢款都有防曬功能，調色加防曬二合一，正正就係我想要嘅。質地超滑又有水光感，唔會太白，剛剛好 💯

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Tone Brightening Tone-Up Sunscreen 50mL
reviews.text: Most people said it didn’t leave a white cast, however it definitely did for me. I have been recently suffering from a broken skin barrier so I wanted to protect it from UV rays. Thus, I didn’t rub it in too hard. Made me look super pale.
reviews.zh: 大部分人都話唔會泛白，但我用就一定會。我近排皮膚屏障受損，所以想用佢阻擋紫外線，於是冇好用力搓開。結果搞到塊面白到爆。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Tone Brightening Tone-Up Sunscreen 50mL
reviews.text: Overall the sunscreen is great, I did order the tone up one but I didn’t expect it to be as light as it was. It did on the other hand have a very nice texture and I like using it under my makeup!
reviews.zh: 整體嚟講防曬係好嘅，我確實係 order 咗調色嗰款，但係冇預料到咁淺色。不過質地真係好好，我鍾意用佢打底再上妝！

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Tone Brightening Tone-Up Sunscreen 50mL
reviews.text: i rly wanted to like this but it was just awful. it’s the color of clay and left a weird white cast on my face. it sat horribly under makeup and made my face look rly greasy. i was upset bc i’ve heard good things abt the brand :(
reviews.zh: 我真係好想鍾意佢，但實在太差。顏色似泥，塊面留低咗怪異嘅白感。搽咗之後上面上妝效果超差，搞到塊面油笠笠。因為聽過呢個品牌嘅好評所以我好失望 :(

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Tone Brightening Tone-Up Sunscreen 50mL
reviews.text: I love it!!! Best sunscreen for me. I have porcelain skin, but if it’s cold, it changes to blue-purple colour. With this sunscreen my face doesn’t look blue😂😂 Doesn’t make me have allergies. If I apply any other sunscreen on my sensitive skin, it will feel itchy, burning and red, but not with this one. I highly recommend it for everyone who have light skin colour.
reviews.zh: 我超鍾意呢隻防曬！！！最適合我嘅防曬。我本身係瓷白肌膚，不過一凍就會變成藍紫色。搽咗呢隻防曬之後塊面就唔會變藍😂😂 唔會令我敏感。我用其他防曬喺敏感肌上都會覺得痕、灼熱同泛紅，但呢隻就唔會。膚色淺嘅朋友我強烈推薦。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
